items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: I guess, one of Panacier's books, uh, I think also in an Armed Services edition.

ctx.x: Yeah, uh, I read the record change. I remember reading that at Orange and Vine sometimes. Yeah. I don't know about it every month. I just read it.

I probably have one or two of them somewhere, and a jazz, oh, a jazz finder, and a couple of old Esquire jazz books from, well, a couple of the 1945. Uh-huh. Uh, one of them being an Armed Services edition. We've got, I think, a, one of, I guess, one of Panacier's books, uh, I think also in an Armed Services edition. Nah, things like that. Just minor memorabilia.
Yeah. Uh, when did you go to Atlanta? 1962. 1962. Did you hear any New Orleans musicians over there?
